T: Barrels of fish. Barrels of fun.
D: Bilbo and the dwarves cross Mirkwood and Lake-town to reach the dragon in the mountain.
P: Serve the mains when the dwarves are smuggled into Lake-town in Bard's fish barrels.
S: Toasted sourdough fingers with whipped honey ricotta
Ricotta whipped with honey and spread on toasted sourdough, drizzled with more honey and scattered with walnuts.
Garlic and thyme mushrooms fried in butter, on toasted crusty bread
Mixed mushrooms sautéed in butter with garlic and thyme, spooned onto toasted bread with shaved parmesan.
Elvenking's baked brie with red wine figs
Thranduil's halls and the elves' wine cellar

A whole brie baked until oozing, topped with figs stewed in red wine and honey, with walnuts, grapes and crackers for scooping. Simmer 6 halved dried figs in 125ml red wine with 1 tbsp honey and a thyme sprig for 10 minutes until sticky. Score the top of a 200g brie, sit it in a small dish and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until soft in the middle. Spoon the figs and syrup over the top and scatter with toasted walnuts. Serve straight away with a bunch of red grapes and 200g crackers.
M: Bard smuggling the dwarves in barrels of fish

Whole snapper roasted with lemon, garlic and parsley at 200C for 25 minutes, served with roast potatoes and greens. Score 2 whole snapper of about 800g each on both sides. Stuff with lemon slices, garlic and parsley stalks and rub with olive oil and salt. Parboil 800g halved potatoes for 8 minutes and roast at 200C in oil for 20 minutes first. Lay the fish on top of the potatoes and roast 25 minutes until the flesh flakes at the bone. Toss 2 bunches green beans in butter and lemon. Serve with salsa verde of parsley, capers, lemon and oil.
Pork belly with a fennel salt rub, brushed with honey, slow roasted
Pork belly slow roasted at 160C for 3 hours with honey and fennel, crackling blasted golden, with roasted apples.
W: Butter honey cake soaked in hot syrup
Honey cake baked at 175C for 40 minutes, soaked in hot honey syrup, topped with gold leaf or sprinkles.
K: Cold milk shaken with bourbon and honey syrup

Cold milk shaken hard with bourbon, honey, vanilla and ice until frothy, poured into wooden cups and dusted with fresh nutmeg. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp water until runny, then cool. In a cocktail shaker or big jar with ice, shake 2 drinks at a time: 300ml cold full cream milk, 90ml bourbon, half the honey and a few drops of vanilla. Shake hard for 15 seconds until frothy and strain into 2 cups. Repeat. Grate fresh nutmeg over the top. For a non-drinking version, leave out the bourbon and add a pinch of cinnamon.

s.note: Toasted sourdough fingers with whipped honey ricotta
s.how: Beat 250g ricotta with 2 tbsp honey until light and smooth. Toast thick slices of sourdough until golden and cut into fingers. Spread with the ricotta, drizzle with more honey and scatter with chopped walnuts. Serve straight away on a wooden board.

s.note: Garlic and thyme mushrooms fried in butter, on toasted crusty bread
s.how: Slice 500g mixed mushrooms and fry in butter over high heat until golden. Add crushed garlic and thyme leaves and cook another minute. Toast slices of crusty bread, spoon the mushrooms on top and finish with shaved parmesan and black pepper.

m.note: Pork belly with a fennel salt rub, brushed with honey, slow roasted
m.how: Score a 1.5kg pork belly, rub with salt and crushed fennel seeds and leave uncovered overnight. Roast at 160C for 3 hours, brushing the meat side with honey. Add halved apples for the last 40 minutes, then blast at 240C until the crackling is golden.

w.note: Butter honey cake soaked in hot syrup
w.how: Beat 150g butter with 100g brown sugar and 150g honey, then beat in 3 eggs. Fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in a lined tin at 175C for 40 minutes. Pour over hot syrup of honey and water while still warm and finish with gold sprinkles.

d.note: Cold milk shaken with bourbon and honey syrup

Shake hard for 15 seconds until frothy and strain into 2 cups. Repeat. Grate fresh nutmeg over the top. For a non-drinking version, leave out the bourbon and add a pinch of cinnamon.
